description: Search public Sandwich channels, guides, reports, answers, glossary terms, and tools for aging-parent and sandwich-generation care planning. Use it first when a user asks a care-planning question; each result has a title, type and joinsandwich.com URL to cite. Use get_channel to open a channel from the results, and calculate_long_term_care_cost for cost numbers.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 10. Default 5.

query.description: Search query, at least 2 characters, for example 'Medicaid look-back', 'assisted living cost', or 'talk to aging parents'.

name: search_care_resources
title: Search Sandwich Care Resources
